common.disclaimer: A cosmetic estimate of how your skin looks, not a medical diagnosis.

welcome.headline: Your skin, *read* with precision.
welcome.body: One selfie, a cosmetic estimate of your skin, then a morning and evening routine that fits you.
welcome.resumeHint: You will pick up at step {{step}} of {{total}}.

name.title: What is *your* first name?
name.helper: It personalises your screens, nothing more.
name.label: First name

age.title: Which *age range* are you in?
age.helper: Skin needs change over the years. This answer adjusts the recommendations.

tooYoung.title: Lumé is for ages *16 and up*.
tooYoung.body: Thank you for your curiosity. No account was created and nothing was saved. If you picked the wrong range by mistake, you can correct your answer.

skinType.title: How would you describe *your skin*?
skinType.helper: Bare, at the end of the day. If in doubt, the first scan will refine the answer.

goals.title: What would you like to *improve* first?
goals.helper: Three goals at most, to keep the routine readable.
goals.full: Three goals chosen. Remove one to change.

sensitivities.title: Any ingredients your skin *tolerates poorly*?
sensitivities.helper: They will be left out of your recommendations and flagged when you scan products.

routine.title: Where does your *routine* stand today?
routine.helper: There is no right answer: we start from where you are.

lifestyle.title: A few markers of your *lifestyle*.
lifestyle.helper: Sleep, hydration and sun show on the skin. These markers put your results in context.

proof.title: *Visible* progress, at your own pace.
proof.helper: A regular scan, in the same light, draws your curve. You watch your skin evolve, with no numbers promised.
proof.caption: Illustrative curve

routine.title: Morning and evening routine
routine.body: Built from your profile and your first scan.

scan.title: Guided scan
scan.body: Same light, same framing: comparable results.

progress.title: Progress tracking
progress.body: Your indicators evolve, scan after scan.

consent.title: Your photos stay *yours*.
consent.helper: Lumé needs a selfie to estimate how your skin looks. Here is exactly what we do with it.

facts.purpose: Your photos are used only for the cosmetic estimate of your skin, never to train a model.
facts.hosting: They are hosted in the European Union, in a private space reachable from your account only.
facts.retention: You choose to keep them to track your progress, or to delete them after each analysis.
facts.deletion: You can withdraw this consent and delete your account at any time, from the app.

consent.keepPhotosHint: To compare your scans over time. When off, each photo is deleted after the analysis.
consent.statement: I agree that Lumé analyses my face photos to estimate how my skin looks, under the conditions described above.

notifications.title: A *discreet* reminder, at the right time.
notifications.helper: Two reminders a day at most, at the time you choose. Changeable at any time.

routine.title: Morning and evening
routine.body: A brief reminder for your routine, at your hours.

rescan.title: Next scan
rescan.body: When it is time to measure your progress.

captureGuide.title: Three habits for a *reliable* scan.
captureGuide.helper: Consistency makes precision: same light, same framing, every scan.

light.title: Natural light
light.body: Facing a window, without backlight or a lamp pointed at you.

bare.title: Bare skin
bare.body: No make-up or glossy skincare, hair pulled back.

center.title: Face centred
center.body: Front on, eyes on the lens, at arm's length.

done.title: Thank you {{name}}, your *profile* is ready.
done.body: Your routine will be built from these answers and your first scan.

skinTypeHint.unknown: The first scan will help you find out.

routineLevelHint.none: No routine yet, or water and that's it.
routineLevelHint.basic: Cleanser and moisturiser, more or less regularly.

home.headline: Your *profile* is saved.
home.body: Your routine will be built from these answers and your first scan.

nextScan.title: Your first scan
nextScan.body: A selfie in daylight, no make-up, face centred. Lumé will guide you step by step.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.body: Lumé follows your device setting, or the appearance you choose.

language.title: Language
language.body: The app's texts, routines and explanations.

photos.title: Photo consent
photos.body: Your consent and the retention of your photos are managed here, at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy summary
privacy.body: The essentials of what Lumé does with your data, in plain language.

points.sensitive: Your face photos and your answers about your skin are sensitive data under the GDPR. They are processed only with your explicit consent.
points.hosting: Your data is hosted in the European Union.
points.storage: Photos are stored in a private space; every access goes through a signed link valid for a few minutes.
points.ai: The analysis is performed by a vision model called from our servers. The chosen provider commits not to train its models on your images.
points.retention: You choose to keep your photos to track your progress, or to delete them after each analysis.
points.deletion: You can withdraw your consent and delete your entire account from the app.
points.analytics: Usage statistics contain no skin data and no photos.
points.notMedical: Lumé provides cosmetic estimates of how the skin looks, never a medical diagnosis.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This screen does not exist, or not anymore.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.subtitle: Phase 0 tokens and components, to review in light and dark mode.

brand.hint: Generative aura in Skia, Fraunces wordmark, one italic accent in headlines.

colors.contrastHint: Running text: 4.5 minimum. Large text and components: 3 minimum.

typography.body: A cosmetic estimate of how your skin looks, never a diagnosis.
typography.bodySmall: Fragrance-free cleansing gel, morning and evening, on damp skin.
typography.caption: Updated 2 days ago

spacing.hint: 4 pt base. Side margins 20 pt, 24 pt on large screens.

icons.hint: Phosphor, light weight, two sizes: 20 and 24 pt.

controls.ageError: Lumé is for ages 16 and up.

surfaces.nextScanBody: Same light, no make-up, face centred.

loading.hint: Soft shimmer skeletons, never a spinner.

signature.label: Skin score
signature.hint: Drawn in Skia: a sixty-mark dial, a ring that fills with a spring and a number that counts along.

motion.hint: Tap a spring to see it.

haptics.unavailable: Haptic feedback is not available on the web.

sheet.hint: Settings and details open in a native sheet sized to its content.
